summary.zh-CN: DeskBox 2026101304 x64 直发版：自动更新先从 GitHub 下载，失败后改用 HTTP 备用站，并按清单 SHA-256 校验安装包。主程序采用 Native AOT，本次暂无 ARM64 安装包。
summary.en-US: DeskBox 2026101304 tries GitHub first, then an HTTP mirror if needed, verifying the installer against the manifest SHA-256. The main x64 app uses Native AOT; ARM64 is not available yet.
